verdict.rationale: Insomnia documents a login-free Scratch Pad ("No login ever required") and a Local Vault project storage option. It also offers Git Sync to any third-party repository "without going through the cloud," so project data can stay local. missing for 10: explicit documentation that Local Vault projects (not just Scratch Pad) work fully offline with no account, details on any feature limits of account-free use, and independent hands-on confirmation of offline operation.
